title: Recent Payroll Bonus Schedule — Pocketwire Advance Room
content:
The room for a new Pocketwire Advance takes account of the customer's most recent payroll into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account. When the linked personal account received direct deposits totalling at least twice the monthly direct deposit requirement of the line's tier from at least two deposits in the month before the handling date, 50.00 is added to the room; when the deposits in that month total at least the requirement from at least the tier's required number of deposits without meeting both parts of the higher test, 25.00 is added to the room; otherwise the payroll adds nothing to the room.

**The window.** A window of one month before the handling date covers the records dated after the same day of the month one month before the handling date, up to and including the handling date. With a hypothetical handling date of 25 September, the window holds the direct deposits dated after 25 August up to and including 25 September.

**What is counted.** The direct deposit entries on the ledger of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account dated in the window: their total and their number.

## Schedule by tier

| Tier of the line | Monthly requirement | Higher test (50.00): total of at least twice it, from at least 2 deposits | Lower test (25.00): total of at least the requirement, from at least this many deposits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 300.00 | 600.00 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 800.00 | 1600.00 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 1200.00 | 2400.00 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 1800.00 | 3600.00 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 2500.00 | 5000.00 | 2 |

## Combinations (hypothetical)

| Tier | Deposits in the window | Total | Added to the room |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 2 | 1000.00 | 50.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 1 | 1200.00 | 25.00 — one deposit fails the higher test, meets the lower |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 1 | 900.00 | Nothing — the lower test needs 2 deposits on this tier |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 3 | 1500.00 | 25.00 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 2 | 1100.00 | Nothing — below the 1200.00 requirement |
